actionsTaken: Published @red-cup-engineering/openai-compatible-chat-completion-service@0.2.0 (additive over the published 0.1.0): corrected the three armed rows' apiKeyEnvVar to their real house names, recorded classification/note/defaultModel per row from the live assays above, added a routingPolicy block (freeFirstOrder: ollama-local, gemini-direct, groq, openrouter), and added selectFreeFirstProvider/isRateLimitRefusal/resolveFreeFirstAttemptPacket plus a new dispatch-free-first-chat-completion CLI bin implementing that policy with retry-on-429-only semantics.

Live-smoke-tested the free-first CLI end to end against the real armed catalog: it correctly skipped ollama-local (OLLAMA_API_KEY unset in this shell) and completed through gemini-direct using that row's own defaultModel, even when the caller's packet named an unrelated placeholder model -- proving the per-row model resolution fix (a real bug caught before publish: an earlier draft of the CLI reused one packet.model across every provider it tried, which would have broken any provider whose current model id differs from the first).

scopeDecisionRecorded: This session did NOT attempt to wire gemini-direct/groq/openrouter/cerebras/mistral into the full A2A/RMN sovereign-provider market (content/provider-admissions, signed Agent Cards, JWKS signing, EVM settlement accounts) that inference-dispatch-service's mcp__inference-dispatch__dispatch_inference tool actually solicits offers from. The prior same-day session record already filed that migration (standing up one Agent Card server per provider, or migrating the existing hand-rolled RMN/A2A executors onto this adapter via migrate-consumer) as an explicit, out-of-pass follow-up -- it is a multi-provider infrastructure build, not a same-pass credential-arming task. Today's work instead completes and hardens the sibling generic-adapter path (openai-compatible-chat-completion-service), which is the shared dispatch surface that A2A wiring is meant to sit on top of once built. A caller today reaches free-tier cloud inference through this adapter's CLI/exports directly, not yet through the MCP dispatch_inference tool's market.
